original-johto.flavorText: Every time it ya­ wns, SHELLDER injects more poi­ son into it. The poison makes it more intelligent.

hoenn.flavorText: It undertakes research every day to solve the mysteries of the world. However, it apparently forgets everything if the SHELLDER on its head comes off.

original-sinnoh.flavorText: Being bitten by SHELLDER gave it intelligence comparable to that of award-winning scientists.

extended-sinnoh.flavorText: Being bitten by SHELLDER gave it intelligence comparable to that of award-winning scientists.

updated-johto.flavorText: When its head was bitten, toxins entered SLOWPOKE’s head and unlocked an extraordinary power.

original-unova.flavorText: Being bitten by Shellder gave it intelligence comparable to that of award-winning scientists.

updated-unova.flavorText: Being bitten by Shellder gave it intelligence comparable to that of award-winning scientists.

kalos.flavorText: When its head was bitten, toxins entered Slowpoke’s head and unlocked an extraordinary power.

updated-hoenn.flavorText: Slowking undertakes research every day in an effort to solve the mysteries of the world. However, this Pokémon apparently forgets everything it has learned if the Shellder on its head comes off.

original-alola.flavorText: This Pokémon is so famed for its intellect that a proverb still persists in some regions: “When in doubt, ask Slowking.”

updated-alola.flavorText: It’s called “the sage of the sea.” It engages in battles of wits with Oranguru, but the result is usually a draw.

swsh.flavorText: Slowking can solve any problem presented to it, but no one can understand a thing Slowking says.
